design: Separate page-scoped repeated-question workload. The user subscribes to a Wikipedia page, receives one free answer before and one after its evidence changes. Same fixed 32 HoH development questions. Page identity is an observable service input, common to all policies. If several evidence pairs exist on a page, select using previous evidence text and query only. Selection never sees gold strings or labeled evidence keys. No transfer pages opened.
hypothesis: At the first generation, save a compact record of the evidence tokens attended to while the model writes its answer. At a revision, use that trace to locate edits for free-form answers that a surface-alignment rule cannot patch. Otherwise rerun the model.
baselines: Full independent old and current generation
Exact shared-prefix prefill reused across revisions
Conservative text-only mapping of whole old answer or changed spans plus shared-prefix fallback
Use the same text mapping and choose unmatched edits by uniqueness without the attention trace
candidate: Use the same literal substitutions as the text baselines. For previously unmatched answers, choose old lexical interval bounded by high evidence-relative attention to the edited stretch and replace it. Fall back to the shared prefix when that evidence is weak.
criteria: In 32 dev questions, screen for at least 20% fewer executed model positions and no loss of exact answers or token F1 versus prefix replay. To claim a native contribution also require two more exact answers than the best text policy or at least 10% less measured lifecycle time at equal-or-higher exact count and F1 than the best equally accurate text policy. Replicate qualifying policies on disjoint pages and measure independently with order balanced, before making any performance claim. For independent scaling, use a separately hashed page subscription cohort disjoint from all reserved full-bank cohorts.
metrics: Same normalized EM and token F1 as prior HoH experiment. For each live policy record actual synchronized time and LLM positions including first answer, retained prefix checkpoint, attention capture if used, decision and second answer. Shared CPU source loading and network ingestion outside the modeled single-page service. No commercial inference requests.
budget: 32 pages, 32 answer tokens per edition, five timed lifecycles per page max; capped at 30 minutes locally; one engineering repair. No paid jobs.
